call_definitions.saved_snapshots_load: Read fixed original h/g/c, qualified J/U/x0 and scale metadata as one packet
call_definitions.initial_tensor_assessment: Independent original g minus initial DF tensor: Frobenius/max-entry
call_definitions.physical_sector: One original physical sector Hamiltonian; original-g kappa
call_definitions.sector_assessment: Initial/final norm and inherited engineering guard, once each
call_definitions.representation_assessment: Initial/final general-K versus raw CAR, once each
call_definitions.initial_gate: Representation and initial DF budget before optimizer
call_definitions.fit_input_load: Dedicated fit process reads the same fixed packet
call_definitions.objective_setup: P0=sum all ordered initial J squared; compute raw rho; verify fstar
call_definitions.optimized_fitter: One existing ffsim invocation and one L-BFGS-B; options=None
call_definitions.fit_initial_diagnostic: Initial objective, gradient, exact/smooth tail mass before iterations
call_definitions.fit_final_diagnostic: Finite terminal objective/gradient/mass even if success=false
call_definitions.final_snapshot_load: New final J/U/x/jac plus saved gamma0/.1 scalar references only
call_definitions.comparison: Separate optimizer/DF decisions; descriptive tail mass; resource fields null

execution_order: Sector36 physical reference and initial sector/general-K
Dedicated fit: load, P0/setup, one fitter with before/after diagnostics

numerical_conditions.allowance_qualification: Fixed engineering numerical pilot, not validated enclosure or strict CA

decision.mass_relation: Descriptive only; within1e-10 unresolved; no resource verdict
decision.failed_optimizer: Finite terminal diagnostics and sector evaluation only; no extra fit
decision.budget_NOT_MET: Record fixed-strength failure; no rho adjustment/rank change/initial-value fallback

later_stages.B: Only after Stage A research decision and separate fixed scope/permission: own-ground/alias, tail law, PF/RTE/A all13 rounds; no evidence transferred across DF
later_stages.C: Only if resources change the decision and separately permitted: own shots/native cohort, same-JU strong deterministic S2; no saved prices/shots transferred

resources.configuration: One fit in dedicated process because of one-fit scientific scope and process-local hooks; cached existing JAX value/gradient; choose threads from actual resources; sector36 reference reused once
resources.noninterference: No shared settings/environment/cache/other-user job changes; task-local cache/output only

stop: Nonfinite or representation/codec correctness FAIL: preserve partial evidence and STOP
Initial DF budget NOT_MET: no optimizer
Unsuccessful optimizer: only registered finite terminal diagnostics then STOP
Final DF budget NOT_MET: no B/C
Normal completion: publish evidence, remote verification, mandatory STOP
forbidden: additional fit/changed rho/rank or gamma search
